Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM chembl_id_lookup WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404') AND compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC.
